question: List the names of leagues in the 2015/2016 season where the total number of matches was above the average number of matches per league that season, and where the home teams collectively scored more goals than the away teams.

prediction.sql:
WITH league_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t1."XCL_005" AS league_name,
    COUNT(t2."XCL_006") AS match_count,
    SUM(t2."XCL_015") AS home_goals,
    SUM(t2."XCL_016") AS away_goals
  FROM League AS t1
  INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008"
  WHERE t2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY t1."XCL_003", t1."XCL_005"
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count
  FROM league_stats
)
SELECT ls.league_name
FROM league_stats ls
CROSS JOIN avg_stats av
WHERE ls.match_count > av.avg_match_count
  AND ls.home_goals > ls.away_goals

WITH league_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t1."XCL_005" AS league_name,
    COUNT(t2."XCL_006") AS match_count,
    SUM(t2."XCL_015") AS home_goals,
    SUM(t2."XCL_016") AS away_goals
  FROM League AS t1
  INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008"
  WHERE t2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY t1."XCL_003", t1."XCL_005"
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count
  FROM league_stats
)
SELECT ls.league_name
FROM league_stats ls
CROSS JOIN avg_stats av
WHERE ls.match_count > av.avg_match_count
  AND ls.home_goals > ls.away_goals
